pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft, non-linear edge gradients; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage pathways with primarily three-way junction nodes; pathway thickness is approximately constant across the upper flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck with low amplitude and medium frequency; silhouette shows distinct pixel-level peaks against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two birds (likely oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal midline, one on the upper neck and one near the shoulder.
